name: The Westin Valencia
positioning: Art Deco style city-centre hotel in Valencia, close to the historic center and the City of Arts and Sciences, with a Health Club and indoor therapy pool
best_for: City breakers who want to be close to the historic center and the City of Arts and Sciences
Couples wanting a room with a private terrace and Jacuzzi

facts.text: Rooms and suites are in an elegant Art Deco style with plenty of natural light.
The Art Deco style creates a spacious and bright environment in the rooms.
The Health Club wellness center has a Westin Workout Fitness Studio and a swimming pool.
Rosmarino serves a breakfast buffet in an airy, daylit interior of honey-hued wood with aquamarine screens.
El Jardi is decorated in a modern Mediterranean style and has a tranquil terrace.
Pets of 30 kg or less are allowed.
Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

highlights.text: Some rooms feature private terraces with a Jacuzzi.
The hotel is in the city centre, close to the historic center, the commercial area and the City of Arts and Sciences.
The hotel has an indoor therapy pool.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack traditional Spanish charm.
